# form.addSwitchField

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Add a switch field to the current form.

```lua
form.addSwitchField(line, rect, getValue, setValue)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | FormLine | yes | the line where the field should be added |
| `rect` | Rect | yes | the coordinates |
| `getValue` | function | yes | the function which will return the current value |
| `setValue` | function | yes | the function which will be called on value change |

## Returns

The new field

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
form.addSwitchField(line, nil, function() return switch end, function(newValue) switch = newValue end)
```

## Used in

- [tool-form](../../examples/official/tool-form.md)
- [wizard](../../examples/official/wizard.md)

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 11 times across 4 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    line = form.addLine("Reset Switch")
    form.addSwitchField(line, form.getFieldSlots(line)[0],
        function() return widget.rstSwitch end,
        function(v) widget.rstSwitch = v end)
    ```

    ```lua
    form.addSwitchField(armLine, nil, function()
        return decodeSwitchSpec(widget.armswitch)
    end, function(newValue)
        widget.armswitch = encodeSwitchSource(newValue)
    end)
    ```

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    line = form.addLine("@i18n(app.modules.settings.activelook_hide_display)@")
    form.addSwitchField(line, nil,
      function() return switchFromConfig(settings.activelook.display_switch) end,
      function(source)
        settings.activelook.display_switch = switchToConfig(source)
        updateSaveEnabled()
      end)
    ```
